name: Music Improved
summary: Choose which microSD folders appear in Music
description: Limit the stock Music library to folders you choose. This filters discovery, search and shuffle without deleting songs or rewriting playlists.
author: thooton

changes.text: Rebuild with the Windows-safe mod checks.
Use the Sonim Messaging and Music icons and restore AppDrawer artwork [skip ci].
Mods: stock-signed builds for Messages, Launcher and Music; remove OEM signing.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Rename Music Improved and preserve installed settings.
Consolidate mod builds and require authorized release signatures.
Add opt-in microSD folder whitelist to stock Music.
Import stock Sonim XP3800 BMusic APK project.
